notes.title: Patch 1.23: 2 new tower achievements
notes.notes:
Changelogs:
- Healthy Cat: Complete the magic tower without getting hit
- Powerful Cat: Get max attack power in the magic tower
- Slight nerf on one attack in Catbag/Catlug

notes.title: Patch 1.22: Magic Tower gamemode is now live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31324386/4b29709a926d89f8163ca96aeea573a49a82bd1d.png

Nearly a year after release, this promised gamemode is finally available. Beware, it is meant for true fighters, ones that can overcome the ordeal of beating the game on hard mode.

Changelogs
- New gamemode: Magic Tower. Adds nearly 5 hours of additional content
- New achievement: Beat the tower
- Some (mini)boss slight nerfs
- Added an option to disable controllers

notes.title: Patch 1.10 - 1.11
notes.notes:
Changelogs
- Nyanko phase 2 had a wall attack glitch (definitely fixed)
- Reset your save if it gets corrupted
- Fixed a few impossible levels
- Fixed losing one player save when restarting a solo race

notes.title: Patch 1.0 -> 1.9
notes.notes:
* New achievement: Really Impossible - Win the game on medium without dying
* New achievement: Medium Speedrun - Win the game on medium under 13 minutes
* New achievement: Unstoppable - Win the game on hard taking no more than 3 hits
- Credits displayed the same names twice in a row
- Changed sound effects for Mewrio fight
- Mewrio's big ball had a weird hitbox allowing cheese strats and was also damaging the player incorectly
- Multiplayer spawned players outside of the field
- Super hero achievement did not trigger
- Best cat in the world achievement did not trigger
- World achievements did not trigger properly
- Items leveling was not working
- Ballanced a lot of levels
- Fixed max hp not getting properly displayed after hitting a warp
- Final boss phase 1 nerf
- Final boss phase 2 nerfed, shortened on medium and hard, removed cheese strats
- Final boss phase 3 had a cheese strat allowing the player to skip parts of the phase
- Buffed early game (mini)bosses
- Renamed jump refreshers to multijump orbs. They now add a jump regardless of the situation
- Buffed Atk and Def badges and perks
- Buffed death charm
- Fixed extra jump consummable
- Skills are now correcly stacking
- Def calculation was not done correctly
- Icecat's icicles were not disappearing correcly after the fight
- Falling speed when out of water reduced
- Falling speed when dropping from a sticky wall reduced
- Nyanko phase 2 had a wall attack glitch
- Items are now consumed when beating a (mini)boss and hitting a save
- New players will start the game with 100 coins to spend on upgrades
- Restarting a run on online mode single player will work as expected
